children: signed a definitive agreement to acquire Listen Labs, an AI-powered customer research and human simulation platform.

The acquisition is expected to expand Salesforce’s customer and user understanding capabilities, complementing Marketing Cloud, Service Cloud, and our broader AI portfolio, according to a post from Salesforce
Listen Labs’s AI agents design studies, conduct in-depth research, and synthesize insights, automating the lifecycle of connecting with customers and analyzing their feedback.

“Listen Labs has reimagined customer experience, market research, and customer simulation with AI agents that can conduct meaningful research and uncover context behind customer and user feedback,” Aman Naimat, President of AI Labs, said in a statement.

title: Salesforce agrees to buy Listen Labs
